items.title: Rick Margitza interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 22, 2024
items.q: Brexit, LePen almost winning here in France.

ctx.x: This is a question you can pass on if you’d like. As an American living abroad, do you observe the political and social scene in the United States, and how does it strike you?

Everybody that I’ve talked to over here is stunned by the stupidity of half of the American public. They can’t understand how this happened a second time. But everybody is also afraid because a lot of countries here are swinging to the right. Countries are getting more nationalistic because of immigrants and Covid and all the shit that’s happened. So it’s scary. Brexit, LePen almost winning here in France. I don’t remember the name, the prime minister in Italy, but the woman — Sweden has gone a little further to…

It does and it’s striking that half the country feels like you do and myself and so forth, and not to make a political agenda out of this interview but I was curious, from you know the other side of the ocean what the feeling is.
